press_references.value: Flexcompute and Northrop Grumman Reduce Space Mission Preparation Time by 100X Using AI Physics Models, Enabled by NVIDIA

partnership_announcements.description: Flexcompute and Northrop Grumman have formed a technology partnership, integrating NVIDIA Physics NeMo to build AI physics models that automate and accelerate space mission simulation workflows by up to 100x.

press_references.value: Flexcompute and GlobalFoundries Enable Integrated Design and Simulation on GF Silicon Photonics Platform

partnership_announcements.description: Flexcompute and GlobalFoundries entered into a collaboration to integrate GlobalFoundries' silicon photonics technology stack into Flexcompute's PhotonForge simulation platform, providing GF customers with foundry-aligned photonic design and simulation capabilities.

press_references.value: Flexcompute and Bramble CFD Partner to Deliver Best-in-Class Motorsport Simulation Workflows

partnership_announcements.description: Flexcompute announced a new strategic partnership with Bramble CFD to embed its GPU-native Flow360 solver into Bramble CFD's cloud platform, creating specialized simulation workflows for motorsport and high-performance vehicle development.

press_references.value: Flexcompute and Rescale Partner to Accelerate Physics AI Development with GPU-Native Simulation

partnership_announcements.description: Flexcompute and Rescale announced a strategic partnership integrating Flexcompute's Flow360 GPU-native physics simulation with Rescale's cloud engineering platform to accelerate large-scale physics AI development for joint customers.

press_references.value: Elysian Selects Flexcompute's Flow360 CFD Solver for Development of Battery-Electric E9X Aircraft

partnership_announcements.description: Elysian Aircraft selected Flexcompute's Flow360 GPU-native CFD solver as its platform to develop the battery-electric E9X airliner, enabling faster aerodynamic design cycles.

press_references.value: At AIAA Aviation Forum, Flexcompute and Robinson Helicopter Announce CFD Partnership for All-New R88 Helicopter

partnership_announcements.description: Flexcompute and Robinson Helicopter Company announced a new partnership to use Flexcompute's Flow360 CFD platform in the development of the all-new Robinson R88 helicopter, aiming to accelerate design and improve performance.

press_references.value: Flexcompute Provides Vertical Aerospace With Latest Simulation Technology to Pioneer Electric Aviation

partnership_announcements.description: Flexcompute and Vertical Aerospace have announced a new partnership to advance the design and development of Vertical Aerospace's VX4 Electric Vertical Take-Off and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft using Flexcompute's latest GPU-native simulation technology. The collaboration aims to accelerate aerodynamic development, reduce testing cycles, and optimize performance for electric aviation.

press_references.value: Flexcompute Partners With NIO To Transform Aerodynamic Optimization For Electric Vehicles

partnership_announcements.description: Flexcompute and NIO have announced a partnership to enhance aerodynamic optimization for electric vehicles using Flexcompute's Flow360 platform. This collaboration aims to improve vehicle performance and energy efficiency, setting new benchmarks in sustainable mobility.

press_references.value: Flexcompute Pioneers Agent-Driven Loop for Autonomous Photonic Design

product_launches.description: Flexcompute launched a fully autonomous agent-driven loop for end-to-end photonic chip design, integrating its Tidy3D multiphysics solver, PhotonForge PDK support, and Flexagent MCP plugin so AI agents can generate tapeout-ready layouts in hours rather than weeks.

press_references.value: Flexcompute and Northrop Grumman Reduce Space Mission Preparation Time by 100X Using AI Physics Models, Enabled by NVIDIA

product_launches.description: Flexcompute, in collaboration with Northrop Grumman and enabled by NVIDIA Physics NeMo, has introduced a new AI Physics model and foundational AI infrastructure that automates high‑fidelity simulations of spacecraft thruster plume impingement for real-time, uncertainty‑aware control decisions, cutting space‑mission preparation times by up to 100X.

press_references.value: Flexcompute and GlobalFoundries Enable Integrated Design and Simulation on GF Silicon Photonics Platform

product_launches.description: Flexcompute launched commercial availability of its GPU-native simulation software Flow360 on Rescale's cloud-based digital engineering platform, expanding access to high-fidelity physics simulations for joint customers.

press_references.value: Flexcompute Showcases GPU-Native Simulation Advances at the 2025 Paris Air Show

product_launches.description: Flexcompute launched a GPU-native radio frequency (RF) simulation product, expanding its platform to offer a complete multiphysics solution for aerospace, enabling full-wave electromagnetic analysis alongside CFD.

press_references.value: Flexcompute Unveils High-Fidelity Physics Simulation Powered by NVIDIA Blackwell Platform for a New Paradigm of Speed

product_launches.description: A simulation technology powered by NVIDIA Blackwell, offering enhanced speed and accuracy for complex designs.

overview_description.description:
FlexCompute is an IT company that specializes in providing solutions related to simulation. It focuses on accelerating innovation with proprietary R&D solvers leveraging cutting-edge advanced computing.

The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.

product.name: Flow360 Solver
product.description: A GPU-native computational fluid dynamics solver for simulating steady and unsteady aerodynamic flows, including aircraft, rotorcraft, vehicles, and other complex designs.

product.name: Tidy3D
product.description: A cloud-based finite-difference time-domain electromagnetic simulation platform for analyzing photonic, optical, and electromagnetic devices through Python and web-based interfaces.
